title: Sonic Wings Special
native_title: ソニック・ウイングス・スペシャル
overview:
12 supersonic hotshots and 24 kinds of fighter planes gather now!

A secret organization called Fata Morgana has seized military command centers around the world and is close to finishing a weapon of mass destruction. To stop it, the special forces unit Project Blue calls up ace pilots from every corner of the globe for an all-out attack.

In this vertically scrolling shooter, pick one of twelve pilots, each with a modern jet and a World War II era plane that is unlocked by clearing the game. Fly through stages around the world alone or with a friend.

- 1-2 players simultaneous
- Vertical screen with vertical scrolling, with a selectable play screen
- Time Attack mode where you race to defeat the bosses
- 18 stages and more than 70 endings

12人の音速野郎、24種類の戦闘機が今、集結！
